question.latex:
![Polarization Reflection](https://cracku.in/media/uploads/image_yxbH5dW.png)
An unpolarized light is incident on the plane interface of air-dielectric medium shown in figure. If the incident angle is equal to Brewster angle, identify the expression representing reflected wave.
(Given the plane of incidence corresponds to the x-z plane such that the reflected ray propagates towards $+x$ and $-z$.)
question.unicode:
![Polarization Reflection](https://cracku.in/media/uploads/image_yxbH5dW.png)
An unpolarized light is incident on the plane interface of air-dielectric medium shown in figure. If the incident angle is equal to Brewster angle, identify the expression representing reflected wave.
(Given the plane of incidence corresponds to the x-z plane such that the reflected ray propagates towards +x and -z.)
question.plainText: ![Polarization Reflection](https://cracku.in/media/uploads/image_yxbH5dW.png) An unpolarized light is incident on the plane interface of air-dielectric medium shown in figure. If the incident angle is equal to Brewster angle, identify the expression representing reflected wave. (Given the plane of incidence corresponds to the x-z plane such that the reflected ray propagates towards +x and -z.)

options.unicode: (E_x hat{i} + E_z hat{k})sin(kx + ky - omega t)
options.plainText: (E_x hat{i} + E_z hat{k})sin(kx + ky - omega t)

options.unicode: (E_x hat{j} + E_y hat{k})sin(ky + kz - omega t)

options.unicode: (E_x hat{i} + E_y hat{j} + E_z hat{k})sin(kx + ky - kz - omega t)
